O1_C07_instrumentation.principle: A full Route-B pass is NOT one OS-level file open. Access must be separately accounted at every distinct layer.
mandatory_separate_accounts: file hash passes (full SHA-256 over the file)
O1_C07_instrumentation.accounting_basis_rule: Each account must state its measurement BASIS, not only a count. A count without a stated basis is not an account.
O1_C07_instrumentation.zero_budget_discipline: These are hard zeros. A single non-zero count in any of them is a STOP condition, not a reportable variance.

SRC02.retry_law: No retry. A hash/config/authority mismatch stops this source immediately.

SRC08.retry_law: No retry. Admitted operation is exact-SHA declared-encoding admission plus a metadata-only reader probe.

SRC12.retry_law: No retry. Same admission scope as SRC08.

SRC26.retry_law: No retry. Geometry divergence between raw header 174 and decoded dictionary width 332 is expected and NOT equality-required.

SRC27.retry_law: Exactly ONE governed fresh pass. A second pass is not a retry; it is a separate run requiring new HQ-bound authority.
SRC27.critical_note: One governed full Route-B pass is NOT one OS-level file open. The pass will involve multiple path-level opens, a hash pass, a metadata pass and a full read. These must each be counted separately.

SRC35.retry_law: No fresh access at all. Replay uses retained material only.

retry_budget_law.principle: C4B's retry/stop law is preserved EXACTLY as frozen. This fan-in does NOT invent a more permissive budget.
preserved_from_C4B: A hash/config/authority/oracle mismatch stops that source immediately.
Retries must be separately counted and reason-coded; a retry may not change source, encoding, variables, operations, or authority.
Candidate A/B/C and measured P2X are outside this warrant.
No excluded source may be opened under this warrant.
retry_budget_law.frozen_maximum: ZERO retries across all eight sources under this freeze.
retry_budget_law.rationale_disclosure: Every per-source max_retry_budget is 0 because C4B froze immediate-stop-on-mismatch and no permitted variation remains that a retry could legitimately explore. A retry is authorised only by a NEW HQ-bound warrant, never by this one.

O1_C08_failure_law.principle: Source, authority, runtime, oracle or required-path mismatch stops the affected governed scope and preserves its failed root.

STOP_triggers.test: observed file SHA-256 != the bound per-source SHA-256
the filled-in access locator does not resolve to the bound source identity
authority refs, authority_id or authority_version do not agree with the frozen authority closure
a selected variable or ordinal is absent, or an unexpected selected column appears
any component of the execution-surface identifier differs, or any invalidating condition in 06_RUNTIME_READER_LANES_AND_RESOURCE_LAW.json.validity_and_invalidation occurs
the executed reader configuration/lane differs from the per-source lane bound in 06, or a digest is published without its lane
retained oracle identity, packet manifest digest or preimage digests do not resolve as bound
SRC14 counts differ from 1917/64363/0/66280, or the fixture identity does not resolve
no ACTUAL trace through evaluate_positioned_subject_possibility is produced
authority maintenance or analytical dependency closure does not cover the produced result

O1_C08_failure_law.scope_of_a_stop: The affected governed SCOPE only. Independent unaffected work may continue only where the issued failure law permits it.
absolutely_prohibited_on_mismatch: relabelling a failure as zero, empty, or PASS

unreached_stage_or_metric_reporting.law: Unreached stages and metrics are reported as null WITH A TYPED REASON.
unreached_stage_or_metric_reporting.never: A fabricated zero or a fabricated PASS.

O1_C08_failure_law.corrected_rerun: A corrected rerun requires new HQ-bound execution authority and a newly issued warrant as applicable. It may never be performed under the present candidate.

difference_discipline.rule: Any difference must be classified with its exact failed determinant before the run proceeds. An unclassified difference is itself a STOP condition.

measurement_basis_requirement.rule: Every accounting figure must be published with its measurement basis.
required_basis_fields: at what point in the run
measurement_basis_requirement.explicit_warning: A count of 'opens' is meaningless without stating whether it means OS-level path opens, reader invocations, or decoder calls. These are different quantities and C4B froze them as separate accounts.

hardened_note_on_the_SRC27_single_pass.statement: The frozen 'exactly one governed fresh full Route-B pass' is a WORKLOAD constraint, not an access constraint.
hardened_note_on_the_SRC27_single_pass.implication: It does NOT license assuming one file open. The run will require at minimum: one existence/access check, one full SHA-256 hash pass, one metadata read, and one full compatibility read. Each is a separate account under O1-C07.
hardened_note_on_the_SRC27_single_pass.misreading_this_as_one_open: Would be an accounting failure and is expressly forbidden by Omega-1.
